earlier_scan.note: Only subclassification refs on Glottolog (Lama 2012; Bradley 2002); no phonology/grammar with a stress statement located.

tone_statements.citation: 兰正群 Lan Zhengqun. 2023. 大姚彝语松紧音的发声变异研究 [A study of phonatory variation in the tense-lax vowels of Dayao Yi]. 百色学院学报 Journal of Baise University 2023(4): 22-31.
tone_statements.quote: 大姚彝语属于彝语中部方言，元音存在松紧对立，有区别意义的作用。大姚彝语松紧音与声调有密切的关系，在高平调55、中平调33和低降调21的音节中有松紧音的对立。
tone_statements.translation: Dayao Yi belongs to the Central dialect of Yi; its vowels show a tense-lax opposition that distinguishes meaning. The tense-lax contrast of Dayao Yi is closely related to tone: the tense-lax opposition occurs in syllables with the high level tone 55, the mid level tone 33 and the low falling tone 21.
tone_statements.summary: 3 tones (55, 33, 21) in Dayao Central Yi, cross-cut by a tense/lax phonation contrast that is being reanalysed partly as pitch.

sources.note: Dayao Yi has a tense/lax vowel contrast that is closely tied to tone; the contrast occurs in syllables with high level 55, mid level 33 and low falling 21; acoustic measures (F0, open quotient, speed quotient) show the phonation basis is changing at different rates per tone: special phonation retained under 21, F0+OQ+SQ jointly distinctive under 33, only F0 under 55.
